items.title: Use of Machine Learning in Healthcare

source_refs.note: 'Use of Machine Learning in Healthcare' under topic 6.5, as printed (PDF 80-81, printed 76-77).

blocks.text: In healthcare, machine learning helps analyze medical data and supports disease detection and diagnosis. For example, it can help detect cancerous cells in medical images, identify early signs of Alzheimer's disease or dementia, and assist in the diagnosis of cardiovascular diseases. Doctors can use these results to plan better and more timely treatments.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Provide a simple dataset example, such as marks and grades. Students decide which data can be used for training and testing.

blocks.alt: A central circle labelled machine learning is joined to four boxes: Healthcare (medical diagnosis, predicting risk, drug discovery), Business (customer insights, fraud detection, sales forecasting), Education (adaptive learning, student assessment, tutoring systems) and Daily life (virtual assistants, recommendations, smart homes).
blocks.caption: Figure 6.5: Applications of Machine Learning (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 6.5)
blocks.long_description: The same few ideas, classifying, predicting and recommending, appear in every area; only the data changes.
